description: Four small plastic cups (blue, yellow, red, and green) sit in a row on the counter, with a yellow squeeze bottle off to the right. The left hand holds the red cup while the right hand holds a blue sponge cloth and scrubs along the outside of the red cup, then the left hand sets the red cup upright back in line; the right hand lowers the sponge to the counter as the left hand reaches toward the yellow cup and the right hand shifts toward the yellow bottle.
